title: Audit Receipt v1
description: Machine-readable receipt emitted by every audit-suite tool. Extends the ARA output contract with the execution-status axis (execution-status-axis v1.0). A downstream consumer MUST treat execution_status and verdict as orthogonal: a SUCCESS run may carry a business FAIL; a run without an artifact carries no verdict at all.

execution_status.description: How the run terminated. Orthogonal to verdict.

verdict.description: Business verdict. null only when execution_status != SUCCESS.

degraded.description: true = the audit itself was partial; consumers must not treat it as a clean verdict. Never upgrades or downgrades a FAIL.

location.description: file:line or path, so a human can verify in 10 seconds
